reviews.title: 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Stunning Case with Smart Design & Great Airflow!
reviews.comment:
I recently built my new PC using the Corsair iCUE LINK 6500X RGB Mid-Tower Case, and it’s easily one of the best cases I’ve ever worked with. If you’re looking for a beautiful, well-designed, and airflow-friendly case, this one is a winner.
🔥 Aesthetics & Build Quality (10/10)
This case is a showpiece! The dual-chamber design with panoramic tempered glass makes everything look super clean, and the reverse-connection motherboard compatibility keeps cable management hidden for a sleek build. The white finish with RGB lighting makes it perfect for an all-white setup—it looks high-end and modern.
💨 Airflow & Cooling (9.5/10)
I’m using a Corsair iCUE Link Titan 360 RX AIO cooler on top, plus four RX140 fans on the bottom and rear exhaust, and the airflow is phenomenal. Temps stay low even under heavy workloads, and the included RX120 fans are quiet and effective. The case supports plenty of cooling options—it’s perfect for high-end builds.
• Supports up to a 360mm AIO (top or side)
• Bottom-mounted fans for additional airflow
• Dual-chamber keeps cables and PSU heat away from main components
⚡ Features & Ease of Build (9/10)
• iCUE LINK system makes RGB and fan management a breeze 🎛️
• Tool-free access for panels – easy to swap components
• Spacious layout – even with a large GPU, there’s plenty of room
• Reverse motherboard design is amazing for cable management
💡 Only minor note: If you’re used to traditional cases, the reverse layout might take a moment to get used to, but once you do, it’s so much cleaner.
🏆 Final Verdict: One of the Best Mid-Towers for a Clean, High-End Build
This case is perfect for showcasing a premium build, especially if you love clean aesthetics, great airflow, and easy cable management. If you’re considering it—just get it. The iCUE LINK system + sleek dual-chamber design makes this one of the best cases in its class.
💯 Final Rating: 5/5 – Absolutely Recommended! 🚀🔥
reviews.author: Wakenbank

reviews.title: Worth the premium
reviews.comment:
This case is a joy to work with. It is incredibly spacious, robust, and an obvious effort has been made to facilitate cable management and make the presentation of your work stand out and look professional. This turned my PC into the showpiece of my room. It is incredibly simple to assemble/disassemble, yet there are no squeaky loose panels and everything fits right. Included was more spare hardware, cable ties and screws than I would have ever needed, thank you Corsair for the nice thought. The extra mile has been taken to make sure the little details are coherent. For instance, the extra fan screws the case came with are also white. The tempered glass is of obvious quality and the dust screens on the side and bottom are simple to access and clean. You definitely won't have issues with air flow. I feel I paid a premium for this case but received a product that was on par with the price. The included iCUE fans do help offset the cost, as ordering a set of three by themselves would easily run you around $100.
The two-chamber format, while in my opinion looking better than more traditional PC cases, uses more room. This case is wide and heavy, so if desk space is tight, you should take measurements before ordering (I measure the case at almost 13 inches wide).
There was only one spot I could find where the fit and finish was less than superb, but it didn't bother me enough to knock a star off, only a mention. I would probably buy this case again if I had to do it all over.
reviews.author: Jason Elwood

reviews.title: good compact case
reviews.comment:
this is a really nice case and everything the 3500x SHOULD have been (because they're not cutting corners).  the included hardware, especially the fan screws, is really nice.  the metal is strong and this tears down and builds up similar to a lian li case.
I love the pop off windows!
it's a little heavy (which isn't necessarily a bad thing) and room to work with is limited (because it's an itx) but cable management is nice.
the Icue system is really nice, but a little confusing.  they only include 1 hub with the case and the hubs can only attach 2 sets of devices, and that's a little annoying BUT the fans that come with are nicer than the general Corsair fans.  so if you commit to iCue, this is a good place to start and it will avoid you some clutter.
airflow is good, color is nice and I love that they include rubber covers on the wire insert holes

reviews.title: High Quality, Heavy, Sturdy, Looks Great
reviews.comment:
Rebuilt my desktop in this case, moving from an NZXT H9 Flow.
Comes with icue link hub and 2 RGB fans. Super high quality case, built like a tank.
Moved away from the H9 Flow because it was enormous, and I had no reason for a case that big. Turned it into a treehouse instead.
Make sure you have a micro-ATX (mATX, generally ends with “m, ex: B850M), or a mini-ITX mobo - it’s required.
Gigabyte B850M Eagle ICE micro ATX mobo
9800x3D
PCCooler DS360 AIO
KLEVV - 32GB 6000mhz DDR5 Expo ram
Gigabyte 5080 Gaming OC
It appears to be about 1/2 the size of an H9 Flow. It’s built like a stump. I like it.

reviews.title: VERY BIG case
reviews.comment: Incredible case that has everything you'd want, but it's much wider than you'd expect. I'm happy with my purchase but in hindsight I would have gotten a smaller one so that it's not taking up so much space.
